blind_spots.blind_spot: The AI assistant assumes connectivity that their own Phase I proved the flightline lacks
blind_spots.operator_reality: Kilsar already won a Phase I for 'Kinetic Wireless Mesh for High Speed Flightline Connectivity', which is an admission that the maintainer's environment has no dependable network. Meanwhile Orion is pitched as searching millions of manuals in seconds and generating contextual troubleshooting — a retrieval-and-inference stack that lives in an IL-4 cloud. On a deployed flightline, inside a hangar's steel, or aboard a ship, that assistant is a spinner. The architectural decision is which capability must survive fully offline on the device — cached task cards and worklog capture that syncs later — versus which is allowed to require the network.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Connectivity was scoped as a separate SBIR to be solved by radios, so the software roadmap never had to assume its absence.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Search millions of operational and maintenance manuals, tasks, and work log records in seconds

blind_spots.blind_spot: AI-enriched procedures collide with technical-order configuration control
blind_spots.operator_reality: An Air Force maintainer is required to work from the current, authoritative technical order, and a signed-off step has legal and airworthiness weight. An AI-generated or SME-enriched paraphrase that drifts even slightly from the TO becomes a quality deficiency the first time an inspector traces a signature back to the source. Fielding therefore needs a defined authority relationship — TO as system of record, generated content marked as advisory, and a revision-sync mechanism when the TO changes — and none of that is described.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The commercial and trade-school customers reward exactly the opposite behavior: capturing undocumented tribal knowledge and turning it into the source of truth.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Kilsar's platform ingests your data and generates enriched technical documentation using our proprietary AI combined with human-in-the-loop.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The stated hosting baseline does not match the data they ingest
blind_spots.operator_reality: Wiring diagram manuals, component maintenance manuals and converted CAD assemblies for military aircraft are export-controlled technical data and CUI. IL-4 is not paired with FedRAMP Low in any real authorization — IL4 rides a Moderate-equivalent baseline — and ITAR adds US-persons-only access control that reaches their own support and engineering staff, plus their subprocessors and any model API in the path. Written as it stands, the compliance panel is the first thing an assessor will pull the thread on, and that thread is measured in months.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The panel reads as sales-side compliance copy assembled to clear a procurement checkbox rather than a posture owned by someone accountable for the authorization package.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: CMMC 2, Soc2, and IL-4 / FedRamp Low

opener_hook: Your 2023 Phase I was for wireless mesh to get connectivity onto the flightline, which means the environment Orion is meant to serve already failed the network test — and Orion's headline capability is searching millions of manuals in seconds.
what_they_do: An AI platform (Orion) that turns technical manuals and expert tribal knowledge into guided, step-by-step maintenance workflows for technicians and USAF maintainers.
